all_residual_as_per_update_stress.assumption: Treats every second of measured non-step residual as if it recurred at every formal update. This deliberately over-allocates call/epoch setup and is a stress bound, not an expected runtime.

fixed_call_residual_floor.assumption: The measured non-step residual is paid once per formal decoder-block call; this is a lower scenario, not a measured decomposition.

remote_report_scaling.assumption: Preserves the remote report's residual scaling by samples divided by observed smoke updates.

cost_model_audit.interpretation: The single-call residual is not separated into per-call, per-epoch, and per-update components. The remote central estimate's 0.687 h is reproduced, but its residual extrapolation is not uniquely identified by these smoke calls. The conservative stress case assigns the full observed residual to every formal update; even then the 24 h gate passes.

limitations: L12 and L23 use native FP16 full-model prefix activations; sequentially quantized-prefix equivalence is not tested.
Dense export timing is an FP16 state copy/serialization/reload proxy; W4 dequantization and its peak memory were not measured.
Three representative layers and 11 measured steps support a preflight estimate, not a formal 20-epoch run or a quality/PPL conclusion.
The Kaggle session wall-time budget was unavailable; block-level checkpoint/resume remains required for the formal run.
